Day 1 · 2026-11-24 · Roku sideload build v1.1.0

KART for Roku

A fake-3D kart race for the TV: three laps of a curving course against three bot racers. Five lanes, and every lane is its own track. Where the road splits, tap Left or Right to jump the gap to the other track. Grab item blocks and hit the karts ahead with shells.

Download

Download kart_roku.zip
  • Published only after the package security check passes
  • Game code and images only: no network calls, no store or account access
  • Scanned for keys and tokens before every release
  • Unsigned developer build: install it yourself with Roku developer mode (steps below)

Source and release notes: github.com/leftbrain847/kart_roku/releases

Play it on your Roku

Kart isn't in the Roku Channel Store. You install it yourself with Roku's developer mode, a built-in feature on every Roku player and Roku TV. It's free and takes about five minutes. You need the Roku remote and a phone or computer on the same Wi-Fi.

  1. On the Roku remote press Home ×3, Up ×2, Right, Left, Right, Left, Right. Choose to enable the installer, accept the developer licence, set a password, and let the Roku restart. Note the address it shows.
  2. On your phone or computer, download kart_roku.zip with the button above. Then open that address (for example http://192.168.1.20) and sign in as rokudev with your password.
  3. Upload the zip and press Install. Kart starts on the TV, and it stays on your home screen as a dev app.

Is it safe? Developer mode adds a password-protected install page that only devices on your home network can reach. Kart makes no internet connections and asks for no account, and every release is checked for network code and leaked keys before it's published. The code is open on GitHub. You can have one dev app at a time; to remove it, press Delete on the same install page, or repeat the button sequence and turn developer mode off.

Controls

Left / Right
Change lane; across a split it jumps to the other track
Up
Throw your shell or banana forward
Down
Drop it behind you
OK
Use a boost
Play/Pause
Pause menu: resume, traffic on/off, restart, exit
Back
Exit the game

Three split zones per lap (2|3, 1|3|1, 3|2) that rejoin after a stretch. Jumping clears bananas. Speed carries through splits. Best lap is saved on the Roku.

From the simulator

Frames rendered by the brs-cli BrightScript simulator during the automated test race. Built for the Roku Streaming Stick HD (3840R): roScreen with Draw2D, sprites pre-scaled once at startup.
